integrity: A new exact family-specific ellipsoid theorem is proved from symmetry, support inequalities and a positive contact certificate. Finite computations corroborate but do not prove it. Planar trapezoid/ellipse consequences are explicitly excluded from novelty.
scientific_limitations: Only integer dimensions at least three and a single parallel cut of a simplex vertex, including the uncut endpoint as normalization; no independent historical-priority review; older unindexed equivalent formulas may exist.
title: Exact John–Löwner ellipsoids and a sharp volume-ratio spectrum for one-vertex simplex frusta
